items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: Well, after I met Ellis when he had just come in for a tour with Norman Brownlee's band.

ctx.x: Oh, I knew. They would come into Whirland. I got to meet a lot of them in the store, I sure did. And among them, of course, Paul Burberon and A.J. Perron. Very many, many others. Right.
So many musicians down there, but the impression of the trombone is especially interesting to me. I think of somebody like, I wonder what happened to Ellis Stratkos during that period. Where was he?
